aasmano aur zameen mein jo bhi koi cheez hai , uss ney Allah ki tasbeeh ki hai , aur wohi hai jo iqtidar ka bhi malik hai , hikmat ka bhi malik .

wohi hai jiss ney ehal-e-kitab mein say kafir logon  ko unn kay gharon say pehlay ijtima kay moaqa per nikal diya .   ( musalmano ! ) tumhen yeh khayal bhi nahi tha kay woh niklen gay , aur woh bhi yeh samjhay huye thay kay unn kay qalay enhen/unhen Allah say bacha len gay . phir Allah unn kay paas aesi jagah say aaya jahan unn ka gumaan bhi nahi tha , aur Allah ney unn kay dilon mein roab daal diya kay woh apney gharon ko khud apney haathon say bhi aur musalmanon kay haathon say bhi ujaarr rahey thay .   lehaza aey aankhon walo ! ibrat hasil kerlo .
aur agar Allah ney unn ki qismat mein jala watni naa likh di hoti to woh duniya hi mein unn ko azab dey deta ,   albatta aakhirat mein unn kay liye dozakh ka azab hai .
yeh iss liye kay unhon ney Allah aur uss kay Rasool say dushmani thaani , aur jo shaks Allah say dushmani kerta hai , to Allah bara sakht azab denay wala hai .
tum ney khujoor kay jo darkht kaatay , ya unhen apni jarron per kharra rehney diya , to yeh sabb kuch Allah kay hukum say tha ,   aur iss liye tha takay Allah nafarmano ko ruswa keray .

aur Allah ney apney Rasool ko unn ka jo maal bhi fey kay tor per dlwaya , uss kay liye tum ney naa apney ghorray dorraye , naa oont , lekin Allah apney payghumberon ko jiss per chahta hai , tasallut ata farma deta hai .   aur Allah her cheez per poori qudrat rakhney wala hai .

Allah apney Rasool ko ( doosri ) bastiyon say jo maal bhi fey kay tor per dilwa dey , to woh Allah ka haq hai , aur uss kay Rasool ka , aur qraabat daaron ka , aur yateemon , miskeeno aur musfiron ka , takay woh maal sirf unhi kay darmiyan gardish kerta naa reh jaye jo tum mein dolat mand log hain . aur Rasool tumhen jo kuch den , woh ley lo , aur jiss cheez say mana keren , uss say ruk jao , aur Allah say dartay raho . beyshak Allah sakht saza denay wala hai .

. ( neez yeh maal fey ) unn hajat mand mohajreen ka haq hai jinhen apney gharon aur apney maalon say bey dakhal kiya gaya hai .   woh Allah ki taraf say fazal aur uss ki khushnoodi kay talab gaar hain , aur Allah aur uss kay Rasool ki madad kertay hain . yehi log hain jo raast baaz hain .

. ( aur yeh maal fey ) unn logon  ka haq hai jo pehlay hi say iss jagah ( yani madina mein ) emaan kay sath muqeem hain ,   jo koi unn kay paas hijrat ker kay aata hai , yeh uss say mohabbat kertay hain , aur jo kuch unn ( mohajreen ) ko diya jata hai , yeh apney seenon mein uss ki koi khuwaish bhi mehsoos nahi kertay , aur unn ko apney aap per tarjeeh detay hain , chahye unn per tang dasti ki halat guzar rahi ho .   aur jo log apni tabiyat kay bukhul say mehfooz hojayen , wohi hain jo falah paaney walay hain .

aur ( yeh maal fey ) unn logon  ka bhi haq hai jo inn ( mohajreen aur ansaar ) kay baad aaye ,   woh yeh kehtay hain kay :  aey humaray perwerdigar ! humari bhi maghfirat farmaiye , aur humaray unn bhaiyon ki bhi jo hum say pehlay emaan laa-chukay hain , aur humaray dilon mein emaan laney walon kay liye koi bughz naa rakhiye . aey humaray perwerdigar ! aap boht shafiq , boht meharban hain .

kiya tum ney unn ko nahi dekha jinhon ney munafiqat say kaam liya hai kay woh apney unn bhaiyon say jo kafir ehal-e-kitab mein say hain yeh kehtay hain kay :  agar tumhen nikala gaya to hum bhi tumharay sath niklen gay , aur tumharay baaray mein kabhi kissi aur ka kehna nahi maanen gay , aur agar tum say jang ki gaee to hum tumhari madad keren gay .  aur Allah gawahi deta hai kay yeh log bilkul jhootay hain .

yeh pakki baat hai kay agar inn ( ehal-e-kitab ) ko nikala gaya to yeh unn kay sath nahi niklen gay ,   aur agar unn say jang ki gaee to yeh unn ki madad nahi keren gay , aur agar bil-farz unn ki madad ki bhi to peeth pher ker bhagen gay , phir inn ki koi madad nahi keray ga .
. ( musalmano ! ) haqeeqat yeh hai kay inn kay dilon mein tumhari dehshat Allah say ziyada hai . yeh iss liye kay yeh woh log hain jinhen samajh nahi hai .

yeh sabb log ikatthay ho ker bhi tum say jang nahi keren gay , magar aesi bastiyon mein jo qalon mein mehfooz hon , ya phir deewaron kay peechay chup ker . inn ki aapas ki mukhalfaten boht sakht hain . tum enhen ikattha samajhtay ho , halankay inn kay dil phatay huye hain . yeh iss liye kay yeh woh log hain jinhen aqal nahi hai .
inn ki halat unn logon  ki si hai jo inn say kuch hi pehlay apney kartoot ka maza chakh chukay hain   aur inn kay liye dardnak azab hai .

inn ki misal shetan ki si hai kay woh insan say kehta hai kay :  kafir hoja  phir jab woh kafir hojata hai to kehta hai kay :  mein tujh say bari hun , mein to Allah say darta hun jo saray jahano ka perwerdigar hai .
chunacheh inn dono ka anjam yeh hai kay woh dono dozakh mein hon gay jahan woh hamesha rahen gay . aur yehi zulm kernay walon ki saza hai .

aey emaan walo ! Allah say daro , aur her shaks yeh dekhay kay uss ney kal kay liye kiya aagay bheja hai . aur Allah say daro . yaqeen rakho kay jo kuch tum kertay ho , Allah uss say poori tarah ba-khabar hai .
aur tum unn jaisay naa hojana jo Allah ko bhool bethay thay , to Allah ney unhen khud apney aap say ghafil kerdiya .   wohi log hain jo nafarman hain .
jannat walay aur dozakh walay barabar nahi hosaktay . jannat walay hi woh hain jo kamiyab hain .

agar hum ney yeh Quran kissi pahar per utaara hota to tum ussay dekhtay kay woh Allah kay roab say jhuka jaraha hai , aur phata parrta hai . aur hum yeh misalen logon  kay samney iss liye biyan kertay hain takay woh ghor-o-fiker say kaam len .
woh Allah wohi hai jiss kay siwa koi mabood nahi . woh chupi aur khuli her baat ko janney wala hai . wohi hai jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai .

woh Allah wohi hai jiss kay siwa koi mabood nahi hai , jo badshah hai , taqadduss ka malik hai , salamti denay wala hai , aman bakhshney wala hai , sabb ka nigehban hai , baray iqtidar wala hai , her kharabi ki islaah kernay wala hai , barai ka malik hai . pak hai Allah uss shirk say jo yeh log kertay hain .

woh Allah wohi hai jo peda kernay wala hai , wajood mein laney wala hai , soorat bananey wala hai ,   ussi kay sabb say achay naam hain . aasmano aur zameen mein jitni cheezen hain , woh uss ki tasbeeh kerti hain , aur wohi hai jo iqtidar ka bhi malik hai , hikmat ka bhi malik .
